scope: Exhaustive source inventory and reviewed semantic obligations; not proof of native observational equivalence or package portability.

abi.meaning: Query only the ROSv2 ABI boundary; migration rebuilds the guest and replaces version-specific wire encodings.
authority: No resource authority is implied by ABI visibility.
verification_obligations: Validate every actual compiled legacy signature against the migration adapter.

capability_open.meaning: Open only an exact explicit environment alias.
authority: Actual caller/environment and independently exposed interface; no Global or WASI inheritance.
verification_obligations: Missing grant, wrong environment and stale caller are denied.

capability_close.meaning: Drop one owned capability handle without resetting budgets or permanently revoking its grant.
authority: Exact owning environment/caller; closing one handle must not silently revoke siblings.
verification_obligations: Duplicate close, remaining handles and later reopen preserve counters.

capability_revoke.meaning: Permanently fence the exact grant and descendants; close is not a replacement for revoke.
authority: Separate explicit revoke permission; no authority over unrelated grants.
verification_obligations: Concurrent admissions, group sharing, failed output, pending native work and reopen after revoke.

topic_publish.meaning: Typed publication with owned receipt and exact native outcome.
authority: Publisher-only endpoint; node/context/type origins; payload validation and destination grant.
verification_obligations: ROS1/ROS2 serialization, identity/QoS, retries, timeout with unknown native outcome.

topic_subscribe.meaning: Create a receive-only endpoint; receive grants never imply transmit.
authority: Exact topic/type, receive role, native metadata visibility and bounded retention.
verification_obligations: QoS/history, source identity, short-output preservation and caller retirement.

multiplex_receive.meaning: Replace the legacy mixed receive queue with typed source-specific reads or an explicitly assembled event stream.
authority: Each source is separately admitted; ungranted sources and metadata never enter the aggregate.
verification_obligations: Ordering, loss markers, per-source correlation, malformed/short output and cancellation.

event_watch.meaning: Observe only explicitly selected source fields and changes.
authority: Observe authority on every source; bounded stream capacity and closed event kinds.
verification_obligations: No payload or graph rights from observation; overflow and source retirement.

event_poll.meaning: Read one retained typed event with nonconsuming failed delivery.
authority: Exact stream owner and live origin grants.
verification_obligations: Event order, source generation, overflow, no consumption on bad pointers.

event_ready.meaning: Read readiness without consuming the watched source record.
authority: Wait-set grant plus separate observation grant on each source.
verification_obligations: Level/edge acknowledgement, no lost wakeup, timeout and source retirement.

service_submit.meaning: Submit a correlated request with retained receipt and independently delivered response.
authority: Exact client/service/type and complete origin grants.
verification_obligations: Native response identity, late response, replay, response bounds and unknown effect.

service_call.meaning: Synchronous adaptation composes bounded submit/wait/take; no host wait retains guest pointers or authority locks.
authority: Same exact service/request rights; wait adds no invocation authority.
verification_obligations: Deadline, cancellation, late completion and no blind retry after timeout.

service_server.meaning: A server binds the exact service and request/response schemas.
authority: Server receive and response rights are independent of client submission.
verification_obligations: Request metadata, correlation, abandoned clients and server replacement.

service_response.meaning: Respond only to a live admitted correlation with exact schema.
authority: Response grant and original request identity; no new destination can be selected by bytes.
verification_obligations: Duplicate response, wrong owner, stale generation, lost ACK and failed sink.

service_available.meaning: Observe actual availability for one selected native service.
authority: Availability-only rights do not invoke the service or reveal unrelated discovery.
verification_obligations: Unavailable versus unsupported/failed native probe; generation and retained observation.

provider_features.meaning: Replace the old extension feature mask with closed provider-supported/attested states for the selected service context.
authority: Explicit context/service observation; no environment-wide capability enumeration.
verification_obligations: No positive feature inference from timeout, zero-filled replies or merely configured options.

action_submit.meaning: Submit one goal; asynchronous acceptance, feedback and terminal result remain distinct.
authority: Exact action/type/client rights and per-goal ownership.
verification_obligations: Rejected goals, accepted goal IDs, delayed response, result ordering and deadline.

action_observe.meaning: Return separately tagged availability, goal response, status, cancel response, feedback and result.
authority: Observation of exact endpoint/owned goal and only allowed fields; no foreign UUID discovery.
verification_obligations: Check each legacy event kind and late/duplicate terminal delivery.

action_cancel_owned.meaning: Request cancellation of the exact owned goal; acceptance is not completion.
authority: Independent cancel grant; no foreign-goal scope.
verification_obligations: Owned goal fencing, cancel response, already terminal and lost native reply.

action_cancel_set.meaning: Broader cancellation is a separately bounded selection with explicit permitted principals and selector forms.
authority: A distinct immutable cancellation profile; own-goal rights never authorize cancel-all.
verification_obligations: Foreign UUID, timestamp, empty-set selectors, partial response and unsupported atomic provider filtering.
action_cancel_set.implementation_gap: The registered action.cancel.set carrier currently accepts only explicit owned goal handles. Foreign UUID/time/wildcard selectors and authenticated origin-principal filtering remain unimplemented; registration does not establish semantic equivalence.

authority: Server role and a distinct secondary grant for each response transition.
verification_obligations: Every ROS goal transition, terminal idempotence, wrong role and callback loss.

transform_lookup.meaning: Qualified frames/timestamps and bounded waits preserve transform lookup; local history alone is not native TF bridging.
authority: Frame-pair, clock, history and lookup grants.
verification_obligations: Native TF differential lookup, interpolation/extrapolation, disconnected frames and timeout.

transform_publish.meaning: Publish a validated frame relation through the explicitly chosen local or native binding.
authority: Separate dynamic/static frame authority; cycle, frame and timestamp constraints.
verification_obligations: Native broadcaster qualification; static replacement, revision and temporal bounds.

parameter_get.meaning: Read only resolved permitted keys, preserving ROS1/ROS2 value algebras and missing/uninitialized distinctions.
authority: Key/subtree/namespace permissions are separate for get, exists, search, list, declare, mutate and delete; node/context origins remain live.
verification_obligations: ROS1/ROS2 native differential values; unauthorized ancestors; atomicity, revision, validation rejection and missing-key behavior.

parameter_set.meaning: ROS1 atomic upsert/subtree replacement and ROS2 declared parameter mutation are separately advertised semantics.
authority: Key/subtree/namespace permissions are separate for get, exists, search, list, declare, mutate and delete; node/context origins remain live.
verification_obligations: ROS1/ROS2 native differential values; unauthorized ancestors; atomicity, revision, validation rejection and missing-key behavior.

parameter_delete.meaning: Delete the admitted key or explicitly approved ROS1 subtree; this is distinct from assigning not-set.
authority: Key/subtree/namespace permissions are separate for get, exists, search, list, declare, mutate and delete; node/context origins remain live.
verification_obligations: ROS1/ROS2 native differential values; unauthorized ancestors; atomicity, revision, validation rejection and missing-key behavior.

parameter_exists.meaning: Check exact key existence without granting value, descriptor or list access.
authority: Key/subtree/namespace permissions are separate for get, exists, search, list, declare, mutate and delete; node/context origins remain live.
verification_obligations: ROS1/ROS2 native differential values; unauthorized ancestors; atomicity, revision, validation rejection and missing-key behavior.

parameter_search.meaning: Perform bounded ROS1 ancestor resolution within the granted namespace chain.
authority: Key/subtree/namespace permissions are separate for get, exists, search, list, declare, mutate and delete; node/context origins remain live.
verification_obligations: ROS1/ROS2 native differential values; unauthorized ancestors; atomicity, revision, validation rejection and missing-key behavior.

parameter_list.meaning: List only permitted keys with bounded prefix/depth and stable cursor rules.
authority: Key/subtree/namespace permissions are separate for get, exists, search, list, declare, mutate and delete; node/context origins remain live.
verification_obligations: ROS1/ROS2 native differential values; unauthorized ancestors; atomicity, revision, validation rejection and missing-key behavior.

parameter_describe.meaning: Read admitted parameter type/range/read-only descriptors without writing values.
authority: Key/subtree/namespace permissions are separate for get, exists, search, list, declare, mutate and delete; node/context origins remain live.
verification_obligations: ROS1/ROS2 native differential values; unauthorized ancestors; atomicity, revision, validation rejection and missing-key behavior.

parameter_declare.meaning: Declare an exact allowed key with approved type/default/range; override semantics remain explicit.
authority: Key/subtree/namespace permissions are separate for get, exists, search, list, declare, mutate and delete; node/context origins remain live.
verification_obligations: ROS1/ROS2 native differential values; unauthorized ancestors; atomicity, revision, validation rejection and missing-key behavior.

graph.meaning: Snapshot/watch only the legacy operation's requested entity kinds, exact identities and visible metadata. Single-entity inspection must not require wider list disclosure.
authority: Separate discovery profile for topic/node/service/action and fields; no communication authority.
verification_obligations: Compare each legacy inspect/list operation; hidden identities, counts, pagination and concurrent changes.

lifecycle_state.meaning: Read the exact node lifecycle; local graph and native node bindings must be distinguished.
authority: Node-bound state/transition observation only.
verification_obligations: Native primary/transitional/error state and node replacement.

lifecycle_change.meaning: Request an explicitly permitted lifecycle transition with callback outcome and deadline.
authority: Per-transition grant and lifecycle node provenance; no implicit actuator authority.
verification_obligations: Native callback success/failure/error, replay, timeout and side-effect classification.

clock_ros.meaning: Read the ros clock with explicit clock domain and discontinuity behavior.
authority: Only that clock binding; ROS clock updates/native source attachment require separate authority.
verification_obligations: ROS simulated time activation/jumps, wall offset, monotonicity and units.

clock_system.meaning: Read the system clock with explicit clock domain and discontinuity behavior.
authority: Only that clock binding; ROS clock updates/native source attachment require separate authority.
verification_obligations: ROS simulated time activation/jumps, wall offset, monotonicity and units.

clock_steady.meaning: Read the steady clock with explicit clock domain and discontinuity behavior.
authority: Only that clock binding; ROS clock updates/native source attachment require separate authority.
verification_obligations: ROS simulated time activation/jumps, wall offset, monotonicity and units.

logging.meaning: Emit a bounded approved record with severity, origin and redaction policy.
authority: Exact log sink and level/field scope; no guest path or network endpoint.
verification_obligations: Native log semantics, truncation/loss metadata, rate and reserved cleanup capacity.

publisher_open.meaning: Create the exact typed publisher and observe actual activation separately from queue acceptance.
authority: Publish-only binding; native QoS/identity cannot be fabricated.
verification_obligations: Activation failure/unknown result, actual GID and replacement.

endpoint_inspect.meaning: Inspect actual admitted endpoint/QoS/identity by role; no communication from inspect.
authority: Exact endpoint observation and metadata field scope.
verification_obligations: Native GID/sequence/timestamps are absent when unavailable, never synthesized.

endpoint_retire.meaning: Retire the owned endpoint, fence pending operations and preserve cleanup/effect debt.
authority: Exact resource ownership and close permission; no reopening from an old provider incarnation.
verification_obligations: Retained borrows, in-flight requests, cleanup failure and repeated close.

topic_reserve.meaning: Preserve explicit native borrow reserve with original metadata, sequence and independent reservation nonce.
authority: Exact consumer, endpoint, original source grants and provider generation; no borrowed native pointer.
verification_obligations: Failed guest copy, duplicate ACK/cancel, wrong nonce, competing consumers, expiry and lost native ACK.

topic_acknowledge.meaning: Preserve explicit native borrow acknowledge with original metadata, sequence and independent reservation nonce.
authority: Exact consumer, endpoint, original source grants and provider generation; no borrowed native pointer.
verification_obligations: Failed guest copy, duplicate ACK/cancel, wrong nonce, competing consumers, expiry and lost native ACK.

topic_release.meaning: Preserve explicit native borrow release with original metadata, sequence and independent reservation nonce.
authority: Exact consumer, endpoint, original source grants and provider generation; no borrowed native pointer.
verification_obligations: Failed guest copy, duplicate ACK/cancel, wrong nonce, competing consumers, expiry and lost native ACK.

service_reserve.meaning: Preserve explicit native borrow reserve with original metadata, sequence and independent reservation nonce.
authority: Exact consumer, endpoint, original source grants and provider generation; no borrowed native pointer.
verification_obligations: Failed guest copy, duplicate ACK/cancel, wrong nonce, competing consumers, expiry and lost native ACK.

service_acknowledge.meaning: Preserve explicit native borrow acknowledge with original metadata, sequence and independent reservation nonce.
authority: Exact consumer, endpoint, original source grants and provider generation; no borrowed native pointer.
verification_obligations: Failed guest copy, duplicate ACK/cancel, wrong nonce, competing consumers, expiry and lost native ACK.

service_release.meaning: Preserve explicit native borrow release with original metadata, sequence and independent reservation nonce.
authority: Exact consumer, endpoint, original source grants and provider generation; no borrowed native pointer.
verification_obligations: Failed guest copy, duplicate ACK/cancel, wrong nonce, competing consumers, expiry and lost native ACK.

client_open.meaning: Activate only the exact client endpoint and schemas.
authority: Client role and complete node/context/type origins.
verification_obligations: Native activation failure, response routing and provider replacement.

client_abandon.meaning: Retire local wait/response interest without claiming remote cancellation.
authority: Exact owned request and cleanup capacity, independent of traffic quota.
verification_obligations: Late reply, already complete request and unknown remote effect.

device_open.meaning: Bind an approved device or control-cycle profile; the guest never loads a native image or adapts a host ABI.
authority: Read, command, stop, configuration and maintenance are distinct grants/profiles; pinned host-side driver protocol only.
verification_obligations: Real driver differential behavior; native image isolation; independent watchdog, controller replacement, unknown effects and crash recovery.

authority: Read, command, stop, configuration and maintenance are distinct grants/profiles; pinned host-side driver protocol only.
verification_obligations: Real driver differential behavior; native image isolation; independent watchdog, controller replacement, unknown effects and crash recovery.

device_read.meaning: Read a typed state sample with provenance/freshness, independently of motion authority.
authority: Read, command, stop, configuration and maintenance are distinct grants/profiles; pinned host-side driver protocol only.
verification_obligations: Real driver differential behavior; native image isolation; independent watchdog, controller replacement, unknown effects and crash recovery.

device_submit.meaning: Submit a typed unit/frame/sequence/deadline-constrained command under an independently fenced controller lease.
authority: Read, command, stop, configuration and maintenance are distinct grants/profiles; pinned host-side driver protocol only.
verification_obligations: Real driver differential behavior; native image isolation; independent watchdog, controller replacement, unknown effects and crash recovery.

device_result.meaning: Wait for the exact owned request; received/accepted/executed/stopped/unknown remain different observations.
authority: Read, command, stop, configuration and maintenance are distinct grants/profiles; pinned host-side driver protocol only.
verification_obligations: Real driver differential behavior; native image isolation; independent watchdog, controller replacement, unknown effects and crash recovery.

device_close.meaning: Close/drain the resource with a separately provisioned stop path and retain unresolved physical effects.
authority: Read, command, stop, configuration and maintenance are distinct grants/profiles; pinned host-side driver protocol only.
verification_obligations: Real driver differential behavior; native image isolation; independent watchdog, controller replacement, unknown effects and crash recovery.

service_inspect.meaning: Observe the exact retained native service/client incarnation, identity and each request/response QoS profile independently.
authority: Exact endpoint observation and metadata field scope.
verification_obligations: Native GID/sequence/timestamps are absent when unavailable, never synthesized.

acceptance.source_inventory: exact set equality; unknown, missing and duplicate imports fail
acceptance.design: all targets and safety obligations must exist
acceptance.implementation: derived separately from registered imports; registration alone is not semantics
acceptance.differential: every old operation requires native behavior and authority test receipts; currently unqualified
